title: Transcriptomic profiling of human neutrophils infected with Brucella spp (Homo sapiens Raw sequence reads)
description: Transcriptomic analysis of peripheral blood polymorphonuclear neutrophils, isolated from healthy individuals and infected (or not) with a clinical strain of Brucella spp, and then cultured for 30 minutes.
